title: Cache lookups in a regional store
body:
# Cache lookups in a regional store

## Context
Directory lookups dominate read traffic in the Marlin service, and every lookup crosses regions.

## Decision
Each region keeps its own lookup cache. Entries are retained for 90 seconds, after which the next read refetches from the home region.

## Consequences
Reads stay local and cheap. A changed entry can be stale in a remote region until its retention runs out.
